nodes.name: instrumentation.py
nodes.summary: Non-invasive adapter that converts a CellForge ConsensusResult (any object with .rounds exposing proposals/critiques) into RoundTrace/RunTrace records, including an N x (N-1) critique severity matrix.
nodes.languageNotes: Duck-typed via getattr so the orchestrator class is never patched or imported.

nodes.name: massgen_adapter.py
nodes.summary: Exposes the preflight recommender and run-metric evaluator as MassGen-skill entrypoints that accept and return JSON-friendly dicts, without importing MassGen.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Pure numpy implementations of the paper's agent-consensus metrics: ACE and normalised ACE entropy, ACE_d, critique severity dispersion/max/star, per-round RoundMetrics, delta-ACE, delta-confidence, winner flip rate, TDI and TDI2 difficulty indices, and the RunMetrics aggregator.
nodes.languageNotes: Softmax entropy is computed with a log-sum-exp shift for numerical stability; TDI2 restricts interaction terms to an explicit whitelist so typos fail loudly.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Optimizer registry mapping names (random, cma_es alias, one_plus_lambda_es, contextual_gp) to classes and exposing available_optimizers/build_optimizer factories.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Shared optimizer contract: the Observation dataclass, the Optimizer Protocol, and the continuous config embedding (config_to_vec) plus nearest_config decoding used by every optimizer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural subtyping so optimizers need not inherit from a base class.

nodes.name: cma_es.py
nodes.summary: Numpy-only (1+lambda) evolution strategy on the continuous relaxation of the config space, adapting step size with Rechenberg's one-fifth-success rule; retains a CMAESOptimizer alias for backwards compatibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Renamed from CMAESOptimizer after review because it lacks rank-mu covariance adaptation; alias kept for old callers.

nodes.name: contextual_gp.py
nodes.summary: Contextual Gaussian-process bandit with a factored Matern-5/2 x Hamming-like kernel, fitting an exact GP posterior on observations and selecting the config maximising expected improvement at a new context.
nodes.languageNotes: Exact O(n^3) Cholesky-based GP posterior with a hand-rolled erf approximation to stay dependency-free.

nodes.name: random_baseline.py
nodes.summary: Uniform random optimizer serving as the floor baseline every real optimizer must beat.

nodes.name: probe.py
nodes.summary: Preflight probe: defines the 4-d ProbeSignature and derives it from a single shallow RoundTrace so the Bayesian recommender can propose a full configuration cheaply.

nodes.name: types.py
nodes.summary: Immutable frozen dataclasses shared across the package: RoundTrace, RunTrace, RoundMetrics, RunMetrics and Config (with a FLOPs proxy), plus the default config space.
nodes.languageNotes: All dataclasses are frozen=True so traces are hashable and safe to pass between processes.

nodes.name: _build_critique_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds the N x (N-1) critique severity matrix in agent_names order from duck-typed critique objects.

nodes.name: round_trace_from_consensus_round
nodes.summary: Converts one consensus round object (proposals + critiques) into a frozen RoundTrace with confidences, severity matrix and winner index.

nodes.name: run_trace_from_consensus
nodes.summary: Converts a full ConsensusResult into a RunTrace by mapping each round and recording the final consensus/backbone metadata.

nodes.name: preflight_skill
nodes.summary: MassGen skill entrypoint: parses a probe dict and optional budget, runs BayesianRecommender and returns a JSON-friendly recommendation.

nodes.name: evaluate_skill
nodes.summary: MassGen skill entrypoint: validates a RunTrace payload and returns the computed RunMetrics as a dict.

nodes.name: ace
nodes.summary: Shannon entropy (nats) of the temperature-softmaxed agent confidence distribution, computed with log-sum-exp for stability.

nodes.name: ace_norm
nodes.summary: ACE normalised by log(N) into [0, 1].

nodes.name: ace_d
nodes.summary: Direct entropy of raw confidences treated as a distribution, with validation of non-negative inputs.

nodes.name: critique_severity_dispersion
nodes.summary: Variance of all off-diagonal critique severities in a round (CSD).

nodes.name: critique_severity_max
nodes.summary: Maximum critique severity observed in a round.

nodes.name: critique_severity_star
nodes.summary: Robust critique severity summary combining max and median severities (CST).

nodes.name: _flatten_critiques
nodes.summary: Flattens a ragged critique severity matrix into a 1-d numpy array.

nodes.name: round_metrics
nodes.summary: Computes the per-round RoundMetrics bundle (ACE, ACE_norm, mean/max confidence, CSD, CSD max) from a RoundTrace.

nodes.name: delta_ace
nodes.summary: Change in ACE between first and last rounds.

nodes.name: delta_mean_confidence
nodes.summary: Change in mean agent confidence between first and last rounds.

nodes.name: winner_flip_rate
nodes.summary: Fraction of consecutive rounds in which the winning agent changed (WFR).

nodes.name: tdi
nodes.summary: Task Difficulty Index: weighted sum of final ACE_norm, final CSD, lack of convergence and winner flip rate using default or calibrated coefficients.

nodes.name: tdi2
nodes.summary: TDI extended with whitelisted pairwise interaction terms between the four base features.

nodes.name: run_metrics
nodes.summary: Aggregates a RunTrace into RunMetrics: per-round metrics plus delta-ACE, delta-confidence, WFR and TDI.

nodes.name: available_optimizers
nodes.summary: Returns the tuple of registered optimizer names.

nodes.name: build_optimizer
nodes.summary: Factory that looks up an optimizer by name in the registry and instantiates it with the config space and seed.

nodes.name: Observation
nodes.summary: Frozen (config, context, objective) triple recorded from an evaluator run.

nodes.name: config_to_vec
nodes.summary: Continuous relaxation of a Config: min-max scaled n_agents and n_rounds concatenated with a backbone one-hot.

nodes.name: nearest_config
nodes.summary: Decodes a continuous vector back to the nearest Config in the space by Euclidean distance.

nodes.name: Optimizer
nodes.summary: Structural Protocol every optimizer satisfies: a suggest(context, observed) -> Config method.

nodes.name: OnePlusLambdaES
nodes.summary: (1+lambda)-ES keeping a Gaussian search distribution over the config embedding, sampling offspring, decoding to the nearest Config and adapting sigma with the one-fifth-success rule.

nodes.name: ContextualGPOptimizer
nodes.summary: Contextual GP bandit that fits an exact Gaussian-process posterior with a Matern x Hamming product kernel and suggests the config with highest expected improvement at the given context.

nodes.name: RandomOptimizer
nodes.summary: Baseline optimizer that suggests a uniformly random Config regardless of context or observations.

nodes.name: ProbeSignature
nodes.summary: Frozen 4-d summary (ace_norm, mean_conf, max_conf, csd) consumed by the recommender, with an as_vector helper.

nodes.name: signature_from_round
nodes.summary: Computes a ProbeSignature from one RoundTrace using ACE_norm, confidence statistics and CSD.

nodes.name: preflight
nodes.summary: Runs the caller-supplied shallow round callable and converts its RoundTrace into a ProbeSignature.

nodes.name: RoundTrace
nodes.summary: One orchestration round: agent names, confidences, critique severity matrix, winner index, consensus score and compute tokens.

nodes.name: RunTrace
nodes.summary: A full orchestrator run for one task: ordered RoundTrace tuple plus metadata, with n_rounds/n_agents helpers.

nodes.name: RoundMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-round derived metrics bundle (ACE, ACE_norm, confidence stats, CSD).

nodes.name: RunMetrics
nodes.summary: Run-level metrics bundle including per-round metrics, deltas, WFR and TDI.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Orchestrator hyperparameter configuration (n_agents, n_rounds, backbone) with a flops_proxy cost estimate.
